changelog.description: what yaks.app can do now that it could not lately, in the words the admin gave

provider.description: the provider of the model each letter is written by: the admin's, else the one the Operator's base persona names, kept once the batch is sent

model.description: the model each letter is written by, as `provider` is

outreach_trial.description: a trial run of the Operators writing to their people between visits: one letter per space, from its own apps and use and the changelog, written in one batch and kept as `outreach_letter` rows. Nothing is sent

spaces.description: how many spaces it asks for

shared.description: the prefix every request began with: the Operator's base persona, how these emails are written and the changelog

outreach_batch.description: a trial's batch, sent to the model's provider; its wake reads it until it has ended

at.description: when its letters were read back

dollars.description: what the whole batch cost, at batch prices

outreach_written.description: a trial's letters, read back from its finished batch

trial.description: the trial it was written in

space.description: the space whose Operator wrote it

stage.description: where the space stood: nothing built, quiet, building, in use

brief.description: what its Operator was told of the space after the shared prefix: its people, its apps and their use

dollars.description: what writing it cost, at batch prices

outreach_letter.description: what a space's Operator would email its people in a trial, its subject and words in `doc{title, body}` once written; never sent

outreach_write.description: send a new trial's batch: one request per space, each the space's own apps and use after a prefix every request shares

outreach_read.description: read a trial's batch when its wake fires: its letters once it has ended, else wake again later
